runs.label: adaptive_batched_read
runs.goal: Read lines 1-700 of services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/controller_prompts.py and all of services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/batch_history.py. These reads are independent; issue both read_file calls in one tool_calls batch. The 700-line range is intentional to test adaptive read delivery beyond the old 500-line ceiling. Then briefly explain where the tool_calls action description is defined and what interrupted_history does. Do not modify files.

actions.answer:
The `tool_calls` action description is defined in `services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/controller_prompts.py` in `_VARIANT_SPECS["tool_calls"]` (lines 241–250). Its description says to execute workspace tools only when needed, skip tools for a greeting, select a tool from the available catalog, and provide schema-matching arguments. The same description is incorporated into the generated controller response schema and prompt.

`interrupted_history` in `services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/batch_history.py` (lines 6–19) returns a copied history list. For entries that are tool results belonging to a batch and are still `pending`, `waiting_approval`, or `running`, it marks them `status="interrupted"`, sets `is_error=True`, and replaces the content with a message that the prior execution was not completed and was not replayed. All other entries are shallow-copied unchanged. The requested controller prompt range was delivered in full through line 700.

conclusion: The full schema-owned descriptions reached outbound native function definitions. The first batch delivered all 700 requested lines and all 19 lines of batch_history.py. The model still performed three unnecessary smaller reads before answering.
limitations: Two live requests on one model/account; action descriptions and adaptive setting changed together, so behavior cannot be causally attributed to either alone.
The read test requested batching and a 700-line range explicitly; autonomous read sizing was not tested.
This is not a latency benchmark or proof that repetitive tool selection is fixed.

The file explanation also claimed the action description was in the prompt; monitoring verified its schema/function placement, while the prompt carries separate action guidance and the workspace tool catalog.
